meta.name: Freddy's
meta.disclaimer_extra: Freddy's publishes nutrition for finished items and for the things you add to them — cheese, bacon, sauces, custard mix-ins — but not for the bun, the bread or a patty on its own. Those appear on their allergen table with no figures. So this starts from a steakburger Freddy's sells and adds to it, rather than building one from the bun up. The patty is still visible in their own arithmetic: a Double Steakburger is 190 calories over a Single, and a Double Cheeseburger is 240 over a Single because the second patty brings a second slice of American cheese (50). Jalapeño Pepper Jack steps by 260, which is that same 190 plus its 70-calorie slice.
meta.blurb: Start from a Freddy's steakburger, chicken sandwich or bowl and add the cheese, bacon and sauces — then build a concrete or shake from the custard menu and its mix-ins.
meta.no_build: Freddy's publishes finished items and the things you add to them, but no bun, no bread and no bare patty — those appear on their allergen table with no figures. A build-your-own path here could only offer sauces and cheese with nothing to put them on, so the page does not ask which way you want to start.
